title: Down to Zero II
description:
You are given Q queries. Each query consists of a single number N. You can perform any of the 2 operations on N in each move:

1: If we take 2 integers a and b where N = ax b(a \ne 1, b \ne 1), then we can change N=max(a,b)

2: Decrease the value of N by 1.

Determine the minimum number of moves required to reduce the value of N to 0.
input_format:
The first line contains the integer Q.
The next Q lines each contain an integer, N.
output_format: Output Q lines. Each line containing the minimum number of moves required to reduce the value of N to 0.
